system.text:
When another character cracks a whip across his back and gives an order, the player must obey the orders (so long as the orders aren’t to “stick that knife in your throat” or something similar). He can be driven to attack, to flee, to drop his weapon, fall to his knees or just plain row the boat. This trait does not allow a reroll, it merely forces an action. Thus it can be used to cow opponents or send your reluctant underlings into the fray.

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Orcish and Human lifepath trait

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 349
